description: Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile (its similar-accounts list), up to 5: ID, username, full name, verified and private flags, profile picture and link. No follower counts for the related accounts. Some accounts have no related list (empty result). Unknown users 404; a failed fetch 503 (not charged). Choose this tool for: Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile. Close alternatives on this server: social_instagram_highlights (Story highlights of a public Instagram profile: highlight); social_instagram_profile (Public Instagram profile as a logged-out visitor sees it). Price: $0.02 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
